value: Successive decisions inside one session can come from different folds and hence from different (theta_sym, delta) pairs. The state machine is run on `e_sigma`, each decision already standardised by its emitting fold, so the rule constants are uniform (+1 / -1) even though the underlying thresholds are not. The fold-to-fold spread per session is in the source data (row_type=fold_thresholds); 0 folds drew a reference shorter than the declared 30 s.

memory-less per-window classifier, open iff s(t) >= theta_sym.

theta_sym = S1a natural zero = ((0 - centre_A)/sd_A + (0 - centre_B)/sd_B)/2; delta = 0.25 * IQR(session calibration fused scores); theta_on = theta_sym + delta, theta_off = theta_sym - delta. Recomputed here from the thresholds CSV.

Each decision is one 1 s hop, so a fraction of decisions is a time-weighted fraction of the concatenated valid IW + rest stream. The pooled row re-aggregates raw counters (it is NOT a mean of session means); the pooled AUC columns ARE means over sessions, as everywhere else in this figure.
n = 2 patients, case-level. Eleven sessions from two people is not a population estimate.
